CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Primary endpoint (Clinical Tumor Regression by RECIST) was not met overall. However, there were some responses: PBL arm showed 3/19 responses (16%) including 1 CR and 2 PR, while TIL arm showed 1/2 responses (50% but very small n=2). Overall response rate was 4/21 (19%). 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: Limited subgroup analysis due to small sample size. PBL approach appeared more effective than TIL approach, but numbers are too small for definitive conclusions. 5. CONFOUNDERS: Very small sample size (n=21) with low accrual noted by investigators. High-dose IL-2 caused significant toxicity including vascular leak syndrome, renal toxicity, and hypotension. The trial appears underpowered to detect meaningful differences.
